verdict.line: You win by abusing Parrrley's range to poke without ever entering his threat radius; you lose if you tunnel on chip damage and get caught low when his level-6 Demacian Justice comes online.

brief.thesis: Parrrley (Q, range 625) outranges everything Garen has — Decisive Strike is range 300, Judgment is range 325 — so Gangplank can whittle him down without ever standing in his kit. His only equalizer is Decisive Strike's speed burst to close the gap and silence through it, and from level 6 on, Demacian Justice turns any low-HP mistake into a kill. The 51.6% win rate over 2,675 games reflects that the range gap is real, but it's a lead you can throw by ignoring his execute threshold.

theirWindow.when: His Q (Decisive Strike) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Decisive Strike breaks any slow on him and silences you on his next hit, which shuts down your W (Remove Scurvy) cleanse mid-engage. Stay outside 300 range and let it go on cooldown before you step up.

yourWindow.when: His Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Decisive Strike and Judgment down, Garen has no gap-close and no AoE punish. Walk in, land a point-blank Parrrley or free autos, and stack Grog-Soaked Blade poison before backing out.

start.why: 71.5% pick rate and the highest-sample start (49.5% WR over 2,395 games) — the extra AD and sustain matter since you're trading autos and Parrrley on cooldown, not kiting at full range yet.

boots.why: 51.7% WR over 1,065 games — Garen's damage comes from autos, Judgment, and Decisive Strike's bonus hit, all physical, so the flat reduction directly blunts his all-in.

core.why: Mana sustain to spam Parrrley every 5 seconds without running dry, plus AD/crit to scale your poke damage.
Part of the highest-win-rate path recorded (57.2% over 222 games) — the armor penetration cuts through Garen's health-stacking tendency.
Caps the crit path so your Parrrleys and autos start one-shotting through poison stacks in the mid-to-late game.

situational.when: he's grouping with his team and you need the execute threshold to finish poked-down targets
he's snowballing off ganks and you need the shield proc to survive a forced all-in

runes.keystoneWhy: 51.1% WR at 39.9% pick — the burn stacks with your Grog-Soaked Blade poison to punish every poke, which is the core of how you're supposed to win this lane.

summoners.why: 89.5% pick rate at 51.1% WR — Ignite seals kills through Garen's Perseverance regen, which otherwise undoes your poke damage between trades.

playing.title: Poke, don't melee
playing.detail: Land Parrrley whenever it's up and walk back out to 625 range. Garen has no tool past 325 range to punish you for it.

playing.title: Respect Decisive Strike
playing.detail: When his Q (cooldown 8s) is up, he can break any slow and close the gap for a silencing hit. Don't stand in melee range while it's available.

playing.title: Deny his passive sustain
playing.detail: Perseverance regens him if he hasn't taken damage recently. Keep landing autos or Parrrley every few seconds so it never gets to tick.

playing.title: Respect the level-6 execute
playing.detail: Once he has Demacian Justice (140s cooldown at rank 1), never sit at a health total where a Q-silence into R kills you. Back off and heal with W (Remove Scurvy) instead.

playing.title: Punish his cooldown windows
playing.detail: With Decisive Strike and Judgment (cooldown 13-9s) both down, Garen can't engage or clear poke. Walk up and freely stack poison and autos.

playing.title: Use Raise Morale to enable, not duel
playing.detail: E buffs nearby allies' AD and movement speed, so it's a tool for jungle ganks and skirmishes, not something that changes the 1v1 directly.

playing.title: Threaten overextension with Cannon Barrage
playing.detail: R has 20000 range, so if he pushes too far up the lane or dives with his jungler elsewhere, the slow and damage over time can punish it from off-screen.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, boots, summoners, and win-rate figures above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown-window reasoning and trade patterns are my own tactical analysis layered on top of those numbers.
